brief: Goldman Sachs mid-day color for 9 September 2026 reports a quiet tape into Communacopia day two. The S&P intraday range was 48 basis points, market volumes ran 9% below the 20-day average, breadth was poor with nearly 400 names lower, and top-of-book liquidity at $10.3M felt light. Mideast escalation is the stated macro catalyst, with oil weighing on consumer and cyclical names. The 10-year yield backed up to 4.84 as GS rates strategist Will Marshall flagged tomorrow's first upsized 10-20 year buyback at a $6B cap, above the Aug 19 guide of at least $4B, which the note says is driving yields back towards their 2023 highs. META's Muse launch pulled flows out of the broader internet and discretionary complex, with SHOP, ABNB, BKNG/EXPE and UBER/LYFT lower two days running. High Beta Momo rose a third straight day, up 13% over that stretch, lifting optical, memory and edge AI names while NVDA and AVGO ceded ground to AMD and INTC. The GS floor ran 4/10 on activity, though hedge funds and long-onlys were both net buyers at an 84th percentile buy skew.
